footer.disclaimer: A SuryaPas result is an estimate, not a price offer. The final figure comes from an installer's survey of your roof.

dev.title: Components
dev.intro: Every shared component in every state, for checking against the mock. The numbers on this page are samples.

hero.heading: Solar that fits your home <box>just right</box>
hero.label: Start with your home address
hero.placeholder: For example: Jl. Kaliurang Km 5, Sleman

step.name: Roof
step.heading: Mark your roof
step.intro: Tap each corner of the roof on the photo. Pick the side that is largest and least blocked.

slope.help: Most tiled roofs count as gentle.

facing.help: The direction of the side you marked.

shade.help: Trees, a water tank, or the building next door.

fields.addressHelp: A street name and a city are enough.
fields.billHelp: Find it in the PLN Mobile app or on your payment receipt.
fields.billError: The bill is empty. Type the amount in rupiah, for example 650,000.
fields.powerHelp: Filled in from your tariff class.

verdict.lede: The right fit for this home
verdict.sub: {size} kWp · uses about {area} m² of roof.
verdict.kwp: kWp is the panels' peak output.

report.dayCaption: The panels make {generated} kWh a day. {used} kWh is used at home as it is made; {exported} kWh flows to the grid unpaid.
report.chartNote: The chart itself is drawn on the result screen. The day band sits directly under it.
report.batteryHeading: A battery is not worth it yet
report.batteryNote: A battery stores spare daytime power for the night. It also helps in a blackout, but we do not put a rupiah value on that.
report.batteryCaption: The same system without and with a battery
report.caveatBody: PLN sets a rooftop solar quota for each area. SuryaPas does not know how much is left in yours.

colours.sun: Day. The hero band and the main action on navy.
colours.sunSoft: The ground under hatching, for surplus solar.
colours.alert: The left bar of a caveat. Never text.

type.label: Label
type.textSample: Only the power you use while the sun is up lowers your bill.
